says: In today's version, no law fails if the uninterruptible wrap around the keep is removed: L6's cut cases never read the kept names in storage.
proof: manager.lifetime.laws.test.ts:416-418 checks only left pids and that the run count equals the listed count. With the wrap at manager.ts:660 gone, an interrupt between `kept.take` and `put` leaves a kept name with no run and no live entry: zero runs, zero listed, zero pids, so all three checks pass.
cost: A later edit can bring back a kept name that no host lists and whose run is gone.
